يستكملوا (form X)
# يَسْتَكْمِلُوا (yastakmilū) /jas.tak.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
# يُسْتَكْمَلُوا (yustakmalū) /jus.tak.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
